reading.body:
The Pewaukee Data Center is operated by We Energies, the utility serving southeastern Wisconsin. No IT capacity figure is published for this facility. The research note indicates it likely serves internal utility functions such as grid monitoring, customer billing systems, and corporate administration rather than third-party AI infrastructure, but this is inference from typical utility operations, not a published specification.

Wisconsin has six mapped data center facilities with one publishing a capacity figure totaling 1.6 MW. This campus ranks second by published capacity in the state, though this ranking reflects only that one other facility has disclosed a number, not that Pewaukee is larger or operationally significant for AI workloads. Without published specifications, its actual size and function remain undetermined.

For a reader assessing whether this campus matters to AI scaling, the absence of published capacity is decisive. No facts support that it hosts accelerators, accepts third-party tenants, or contributes to the national AI infrastructure buildout that this site tracks.
